name: hephaistos-kit-search
description: Ultra-fast NTFS file search powered by the Hephaistos engine ($MFT + USN, Rust daemon, no Everything.exe) — Sherlock finds it before you finish typing

everythingSearch.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the everything-search MCP server script. Leave empty to use the server bundled in the extension.

everythingSearch.hpheBinaryPath.description: Absolute path to hphe-mcp.exe (Rust binary, no Python needed). Leave empty to use the bundled binary.

everythingSearch.preferHphe.description: Use hphe-mcp.exe (Rust) when available, fallback to Python server.py

everythingSearch.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to spawn the MCP server. Leave empty to auto-detect (python, python3, py). Only used if preferHphe is false or hphe-mcp.exe is unavailable.

everythingSearch.maxResults.description: max_results sent to everything_search per query

everythingSearch.renderCap.description: Max rows rendered in the webview (rest are truncated with a note)
